items.source:
Turns the arguments of this function into a literal replacement for the SpEL
placeholder (instead of creating Cypher parameters).
items.translation: 将本函数的参数转换为 SpEL 占位符的字面替换（而不是创建 Cypher 参数）。

items.source: Renders a query that may contains SpEL expressions.

items.source: Takes arg and tries to either extract a sort from it or cast it to a sort. That sort is than past to the CypherGenerator that renders a valid order by fragment which replaces the SpEL placeholder without further validation whether it's attributes are in the query or similar literal.
items.translation: 接收 arg 并尝试从中提取一个 sort，或者将其转换为排序对象。该排序对象随后被传递给 CypherGenerator，后者渲染一个有效的 ORDER BY 片段，以替换 SpEL 占位符，而无需进一步验证其属性是否在查询中或类似字面量。

items.source: Takes arg and tries to either extract a sort from it or cast it to a sort.
items.translation: 接收 arg 并尝试从中提取一个 sort，或者将其转换为排序对象。

items.source: This class provides a couple of extensions to the Spring Data Neo4j SpEL support. Its static functions are registered inside an EvaluationContextExtension that in turn will be provided as a root bean.
items.translation: 该类为 Spring Data Neo4j 的 SpEL 支持提供了一些扩展功能。其静态函数被注册在 EvaluationContextExtension 中，该扩展进而将被作为根 Bean 提供。

items.source:
A marker interface that indicates a literal replacement in a query instead of a
parameter replacement.
items.translation: 一个标记接口，用于指示在查询中进行字面替换而非参数替换。

items.source: arg - the sort object to order the result set of the final query.
items.translation: arg - 用于对最终查询的结果集进行排序的sort 对象。

items.source: metadata - the Neo4jPersistentEntity for the given entity. Must not be null.
items.translation: metadata - 给定实体对应的 Neo4jPersistentEntity。不得为 null。

items.source: arg - the object that will be inserted as a literal String into the query. It's toString() method will be used.
items.translation: arg - 将作为字面量字符串插入查询的对象。 将使用其 toString() 方法。

items.source: query - the query expression potentially containing a SpEL expression. Must not be null.
items.translation: query - 查询表达式，可能包含 SpEL 表达式。不能为 null。

items.source: mappingContext - the mapping context in which the query is rendered
items.translation: mappingContext - 查询渲染所在的映射上下文

items.source: parser - must not be null.
items.translation: parser 不能为 null。
